title: WikiBio: a Semantic Resource for the Intersectional Analysis of Biographical Events

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting biographical events from Wikipedia entries using a fine-tuned DistilBERT model and comparing the frequency and distribution of event types (e.g., private life versus career events) between men and women using Jensen-Shannon Divergence.

Comparing the representation of Western writers against 'Transnational' writers (defined as non-Western individuals or ethnic minorities) by extracting biographical events and measuring the divergence in event terminology and focus using Jensen-Shannon Divergence.
